_comment: sim-pad-down-descent-jam-physics-v1. Purpose: find the REAL contacting pair of the coldwin98-100 pad-down place jam (the descent stops ~0.11 m above the shelf, pressing with no progress, while the CPU cage-clearance proof says every link clears the cage by >= 0.10 m) from the composed USD geometry rather than the author_cart box model, correct the model so a disagreement like this is caught, and instrument the next run so the contact is NAMED from physics.
_contacting_pair: The UR10 gripper SUCTION HOUSING (XRDF links suction_cups / surface_plate_1..6 / cube_without_surface_plates) vs /Rollwagen/chassis/shelf (the COMPOSED upper-shelf board; world top-face z 0.9639, AABB corner 0.9712). CPU FK-replay of the recorded coldwin100 TRAJ_HOST_PLAN pad-down descent against the composed mission.usda colliders at the recorded settled cart pose: the housing penetrates the shelf by up to 52-59 mm from the FIRST descent waypoint, while EVERY cage body (posts + side/back bars) stays >= +0.11 m clear. The welded carton is cage-FILTERED (physics:filteredPairs covers all 50 cage uprights/bars) and sits ~0.10 m above the shelf, so it is NOT the contact; the gripper housing -- which hangs ~0.14 m BELOW the carton bottom in the pad-down orientation -- reaches the shelf board first. Cross-checks: the host logged effort=120.4=gravity-baseline with ZERO carton descent (a hard geometric block, not droop); the chase-camera frame at the jam shows the carton held at the cart MOUTH, not seated; the PLACE_OBSTRUCTED carton-bottom +108.8 mm matches the FK carton bottom 1.068 m vs the modelled seat. Proof: scripts/check_pad_down_shelf_contact.py (OK = cage-only sweep clears +108 mm, shelf-inclusive sweep refuses prim=shelf).
_why_the_model_was_blind: The place-descent clearance sweep (place_clearance.place_descent_cage_clearance_provider, include defaulting to cage_body_names) swept the ARM SPHERES against the CAGE bodies ONLY and EXCLUDED the SUPPORT bodies (deck/shelf), on the assumption that only the CARTON reaches the support. In the pad-down side grip the GRIPPER HOUSING (not the carton) descends to the shelf level, so the shelf had to be in the ARM-sphere sweep. Secondary 'mis-sized body': the author_cart BOX MODEL shelf (top 0.9325, 25 mm thick) is ~31 mm LOWER and thinner than the COMPOSED mission shelf (face 0.9639 / AABB 0.9712, 40 mm thick), so even a cage-only verdict read the shelf at the wrong height.
_model_fix: place_clearance.place_descent_sweep_bodies(bodies) = cage bodies + the present SUPPORT board; place_descent_sweep_reject now takes TWO margins -- cage bodies at the 30 mm design margin, SUPPORT board at a penetration-only margin (DEFAULT_PLACE_DESCENT_SUPPORT_MARGIN_M = 0.0), because the pad-down housing legitimately rides close to the board as it lowers the carton. Opt-in via include_support on place_descent_cage_clearance_provider / place_descent_cage_min_clearance_provider and the place_descent_cage_gate HOST block (place_cage_wiring); default off => cage-only => byte-identical with PR 376.
_re_plan_finding: A pad-down descent that clears the shelf by the >= 0.03 m DESIGN margin is GEOMETRICALLY UNREACHABLE with the current side-grip: the housing hangs ~0.14 m below the carton and must occupy the shelf-edge volume when the carton is over the shelf. The housing SKIMS the shelf +x edge at +9..+17 mm on a clean straight descent (landing the carton on the real flat face 0.9639) and strikes at -52..-59 mm on the recorded 'up-and-over' descent (which over-drives toward the box-model 0.9325 seat and swings the housing over the board). So the shelf-aware gate uses a penetration-only support margin: it REFUSES the striking descent by name (prim=shelf) and PASSES a clean close-ride; a robustly-clear >= 30 mm place needs a lane-owned grip/approach change (a top-down grip, or placing the carton at the shelf lip so the housing hangs past the edge). The instrument confirms the real contact on the next run.

place_descent_cage_gate.cart_pose: [x, y, z, yaw]  -- the LIVE coupled cart-body -> ur_base_link pose (same value the gate already needs); z=0, yaw from the measured cart. REQUIRED.
place_descent_cage_gate._comment: include_support:true arms the SHELF check: the descent dispatch + the carry-connected pad-down branch selector now REFUSE a gripper-housing-vs-shelf strike BY NAME (PLACE_DESCENT_CAGE_CLEARANCE prim=shelf, penetration-only support margin) instead of the blind physical jam. margin stays 0.030 for the cage.

_coldwin101_ON_values_RUNTIME: NONE required for the model fix / instrument. The place_contact_logger reads config['place_contact_logger'] (HOST or runtime config, whichever carries it) in BOTH phases of the VIEW-SAFE boot wiring (sim-place-contact-logger-view-safe-v1): physics_setup.assemble AUTHORS the PhysxContactReportAPI PRE-RESET (before the tensor-backed simulation view is created) and isaac_factory.create only SUBSCRIBES the callback POST-RESET. This fixes the coldwin101 crash where the old attach re-authored prims the view already covered, invalidating it (every arm DOF/transform read then failed). A bare true uses the defaults (arm_prefixes /MobileRobot, carton_prefixes /RestockScenario/HandlingUnit, cart_prefixes /Rollwagen, deepen_step_m 0.005).
_expected_console_coldwin101: At boot: 'PLACE_DESCENT_CAGE_GATE armed margin=0.030 include_support=True ... + the SUPPORT board (deck/shelf) so the pad-down gripper-housing-vs-shelf jam ... is now refused by name' and 'PLACE_CONTACT_LOGGER armed on N rigid bodies ... phase=pre-reset bodies=N -- the contact-report API is authored BEFORE world.reset()/view creation (view-safe...)' followed (after the cameras build, post-reset) by 'PLACE_CONTACT_LOGGER subscribed on N bodies (attach phase=pre-reset, view-safe post-reset)'. The phase=pre-reset token is the proof the fix is live -- the run must NOT show any 'Simulation view object is invalidated' / 'Failed to get DOF positions' errors. At the place descent: if the striking descent is attempted, 'PLACE_DESCENT_CAGE_CLEARANCE prim=shelf min_clearance=-NN.Nmm ... would strike the SUPPORT board the carton lands on' BEFORE motion (no silent jam); and from physics, 'CONTACT_PAIR a=/MobileRobot/<suction_cups|surface_plate_*|cube_without_surface_plates> b=/Rollwagen/chassis/shelf kind=gripper depth=NN.Nmm sep=-0.0NNm phase=place event=first' at the first touch (and event=deepen as it presses). The logged contact prim NAMES the pair directly, so the model can never again be the only evidence.
_cpu_proof: scripts/check_pad_down_shelf_contact.py (composed-USD replay; OK = jam reproduced) and scripts/twin/tests/: test_place_descent_shelf_contact.py (the cw100 replay as a test + the two-margin reject), test_place_cage_wiring.py (include_support wiring), test_place_contact_logger.py (the pure classifier + the boot-path attach/wire with injected fakes). All CPU, no Isaac/ROS/GPU. Write-up: data/sim-pad-down-descent-jam-physics-v1/report.md.
_scope: Only the COLLECT pad-down place descent clearance model + the opt-in instrument. The release logic (PR 382) and the transfer stage are out of scope. Every switch is opt-in and default-off => a run without the HOST/runtime keys is byte-identical.
